concepts.title: Fizz glass
concepts.idea: A bold simplified tapered drinking tumbler, pale ice-blue solid silhouette with a subtly curved liquid top and three clear circular bubbles cut through it; largest circular orange bubble floats just above its upper right. Glass is short and substantial, not tall and narrow. A small coherent upward bubble rhythm with no straw, ice cubes, lid or rim detail. The liquid and glass resolve to one clean shape. This is the most direct soda-in-a-glass direction.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original logo exploration presentation board for Home Soda Machine, a premium home kitchen appliance dispensing cold flavored carbonated water from a faucet; also a companion app icon.
Style: exceptionally clean, confident flat graphic identity, geometric and vector-friendly. Inspired by its approved "Big Blue" enclosure display: broad cobalt panels, pale ice blue, warm orange, navy separation, plain sans-serif typography. The aesthetic is bold, friendly precision and excellent simple proportions.
Palette: cobalt #1749D1, navy #10319C, ice blue #DCE6FF, warm orange #FF9152, white. Flat solid ink colors only. No gradient, translucency, realistic materials, gloss, lighting, 3D bevel, texture or drop shadows.
Layout: landscape 1536x1024 presentation board on white. Top left a small navy concept number and title as specified. Main left area: one large cobalt rounded-square app-icon tile with generous clear margins and a single centered mark. Main right area: same mark shown as a standalone cobalt-and-orange logo on white, with the words "Home Soda" on one line and "Machine" on a second line, in clean regular sans-serif navy type beside or underneath it, generous spacing. Bottom right: the same mark reproduced once in solid navy and once small in a cobalt rounded-square tile, demonstrating wider uses. Make all repetitions exactly consistent in geometry. No other explanatory text.
Constraints: do not use any existing beverage brand marks. Not a soda can or commercial soda brand. No roof-house cliché unless specifically in the concept. Keep logo highly identifiable at 32px, strong silhouette and restrained few parts. Craft a real brand mark, not stock clipart or a detailed illustration.

concepts.title: On tap
concepts.idea: A distinctive chunky continuous gooseneck faucet arch, pale ice blue against cobalt: left upright rises into a smooth quarter-to-half circular bend, curves over to a short down-pointing outlet at upper right. A single orange circular drop hangs below that outlet. Compact balanced angular base under the left upright. No handles, plumbing detail, sink, glass or faucet line drawing. The arch and separated orange dot should feel like one memorable typographic symbol. On white, arch is cobalt.

concepts.title: Bubble H
concepts.idea: A custom bold uppercase H monogram, pale ice blue on cobalt, formed from two substantial rectangular vertical pillars joined by one short horizontal bridge. Three circular counterspaces/bubbles progress diagonally upward through the H silhouette, with one orange bubble lifted just above its upper-right edge. Prioritize instantly readable H and a compact iconic silhouette. It must feel purpose-drawn as the Home monogram, with carbonation subtly integrated. No house roof, no additional lettering within icon.

concepts.title: Soda S
concepts.idea: An exceptionally strong custom uppercase S monogram built from two broad smooth opposing geometric curves, pale ice blue on cobalt; square-cut terminals evoke confident industrial signage, with one terminal containing or ending at a small orange circular bubble at upper right. The S should suggest liquid flowing in one movement and remain immediately readable as S. Avoid enclosing circle, avoid yin-yang, avoid soda-brand globe, avoid a ribbon or swoosh. No enclosing badge other than app icon tile.

concepts.title: Two flavors
concepts.idea: Two bold upright rounded-bottom glass-like channels side by side, left pale ice blue and right warm orange on cobalt, offset top levels with a single circular pale bubble rising over the left and single orange bubble rising over the right. The two liquid columns form one compact distinctive balanced symbol, with a narrow uniform cobalt gap; gentle cropped wave at top of each column. Read as two flavors on tap. No stems, bases or outlines. Aim for confident geometric pictogram with friendly asymmetry, not pause button or bar chart.

concepts.title: Cold machine
concepts.idea: A bold highly reduced appliance emblem: one compact pale ice-blue almost-square solid enclosure silhouette with its TOP LEFT corner clipped by a strong 45-degree diagonal facet. Inside, three circular cobalt bubble cutouts rise in a gentle diagonal; highest bubble warm orange as a purposeful accent near the clipped facet. This is inspired by the actual machine's distinctive chamfered side profile and its unlabeled circular status indicators. No buttons, screens, text, tubes, door handles or technical drawing. Make a surprisingly simple memorable compact mark that can be stamped into hardware. On white, silhouette becomes cobalt with white holes and orange accent.
